description:
You are a Regulatory Affairs Manager at Meridian Therapeutics preparing an IND Annual Report (IND 123456) for FDA submission. The document content is complete, but it needs proper header/footer formatting per company SOPs before submission.

The document is currently open in LibreOffice Writer at:
/home/ga/Documents/ind_annual_report.docx

Configure the following headers and footers, then save the result as a NEW file:

1. ENABLE 'Different first page' header/footer (the title page should be treated differently)
2. ENABLE 'Different odd and even pages' (also called unchecking 'Same content on left and right pages')
3. FIRST PAGE HEADER: Leave completely empty (no text)
4. FIRST PAGE FOOTER: Centered text reading: 'CONFIDENTIAL — Meridian Therapeutics, Inc.'
5. ODD PAGE HEADER: Right-aligned text reading: 'Meridian Therapeutics, Inc. — MRD-4721'
6. EVEN PAGE HEADER: Left-aligned text reading: 'IND 123456 — Annual Report'
7. ODD PAGE FOOTER: Insert a Page Number field (Right-aligned)
8. EVEN PAGE FOOTER: Insert a Page Number field (Left-aligned)

Save the formatted document as:
/home/ga/Documents/ind_annual_report_formatted.docx

Use File > Save As and select 'Word 2007-365 (.docx)' format. Do NOT overwrite the original file.
